The**Ministry of Maritime Affairs and Insular Policy**([Greek](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_language):Υπουργείο Ναυτιλίας και Νησιωτικής Πολιτικής) is a[government department](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of[Greece](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greece)responsible for managing the nation's maritime and shipping sectors, as well as developing policies concerning the country's numerous islands. This ministry also oversees the enforcement of maritime laws and regulations, and the safety of Greek waters and coasts.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:YEN1.JPG)The headquarters of the Ministry of Shipping at the[Port of Piraeus](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port_of_Piraeus).
